# AMC Spotlight Grid

<!-- Generated by tools/build-templates.mjs from template.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**List Template** for Universal Theme · direction: motion · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.1

A tile grid lit by one pointer spotlight that travels across all tiles at once, revealing a dot pattern and making nearby tile edges glow, while the current tile keeps a soft resting glow.

**Use it for:** Launchpads, module menus and settings hubs with 3 to 16 entries that each deserve a short description.

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, through the Builder):** App Builder > your app > Shared Components >
  Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_tpl_spotlight_grid.sql` (Component Export). It creates the
  template in Universal Theme and its Static Application File(s) in `amc-templates/`.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/list-templates/amc-spotlight-grid.apx` and
  `dist/apexlang/shared-components/static-files/amc-templates/` into the app, add the entries from
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx` to `shared-components/static-files.apx`, then run the apexlang gates.

## Use

Create or pick a List (Shared Components > Lists), add a **List** region and set **Appearance > List Template** to **AMC Spotlight Grid**. In APEXlang: `componentAppearance { listTemplate: @amc-spotlight-grid }`.

List template for a List region. Each entry is a tile with its icon, text, a description from User Defined Attribute 1 and an optional tag from Attribute 2, for example 'New' or '3 due'. The optional JavaScript file moves the spotlight with the pointer across the whole grid; without it, or on touch screens and under reduced motion, tiles light up statically on hover. Keyboard focus lights the focused tile and shows a focus ring. The current entry keeps a soft glow at rest. Template options: Intense light, Compact tiles, Rows, Night tiles.

## List entry attributes

| Attribute | Meaning |
|---|---|
| A01 | Description |
| A02 | Tag |

## Template options

| Option | Class | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Intense light | `amc-TSpotlightGrid--intense` | A larger, brighter spotlight and a thicker glowing edge. |
| Compact tiles | `amc-TSpotlightGrid--compact` | Smaller tiles with the icon beside the text; descriptions are hidden. |
| Rows | `amc-TSpotlightGrid--rows` | One full-width row per entry, for side columns and settings menus. |
| Night tiles | `amc-TSpotlightGrid--night` | Inverts the tiles to a dark surface derived from the theme text color, where the spotlight is most visible. In a dark theme style the tiles become light. |
